entities.summary: Nathan Frankel was an American professional basketball player. He spent one season in the Basketball Association of America (BAA) as a member of the Pittsburgh Ironmen during the 1946–47 season, but he spent the majority of his playing career as a member of teams in the American Basketball League (ABL). He attended Brooklyn College.
